search_row.title: Mean time to fixation of a neutral mutant
search_row.statement: A neutral mutant that does go to fixation takes on average about four times the effective population size, in generations, to do so.

fields.dct:source: Motoo Kimura (1969) The average number of generations until fixation of a mutant gene in a finite population
fields.delphi:proposedTest: In replicate small populations of known N_e, record the conditional time to fixation of neutral marker alleles and compare it with 4N_e generations.
fields.delphi:context: Assumptions: diffusion approximation to the Wright-Fisher model, neutrality, constant N_e. Formal status: proved within the diffusion limit (Kimura and Ohta 1969).
